note: Layout for the interactive site map. Positions are percentages of the map image (x from left, y from top). Status: 'building' = in progress, 'planned' = coming later. Only Academy Plaza is being built first. The Duel Arena in Academy Plaza is the arena being built; the Training Arena is planned on Academy Hill.

districts.name: Academy Plaza
districts.blurb: The heart of Aurel Bay. The academy gates are the safe spawn, rooftops ring two open squares, and the tournament stage sits in the plaza.
features: Safe spawn at the academy gates
districts.mood: dusk (ClockTime 18), slate stone, navy banners, matte gold trim
districts.lore: The old plaza clock tower is stuck on 4:07. Studio build: matte stone tower, cream clock face with dark hands set to 4:07, no lights. A newer street clock nearby runs 7 seconds behind (planned).
districts.arena: Duel Arena (1v1 Ranked, 120x120 studs) beside the tournament stage

districts.name: Academy Hill
districts.blurb: The academy campus on the hill behind the plaza, with training grounds and the courtyard.
districts.mood: clear morning, clean stone, gold-trimmed academy walls
districts.arena: Training Arena (practice vs dummies, 120x120 studs), the first one being built

districts.name: Gold Harbor
districts.blurb: Docks and cargo cranes on the bay. Tight lanes and stacked containers for close fights.
districts.mood: dawn fog (higher Atmosphere density), wet docks, rust and navy containers
districts.arena: Squad Arena (3v3, about 200x200 studs) in the container yard, with cover lanes for team fights

districts.name: Lantern Market
districts.blurb: Narrow streets of stalls and warm street lamps. Shops and cosmetics vendors live here.
districts.mood: night, warm matte lantern glow (low LightEmission), narrow streets

districts.name: Skyline Ward
districts.blurb: Tall towers and rooftop bridges for vertical, dash-heavy fights.
districts.mood: noon, open sky, wind across the rooftops
districts.arena: Legion Arena (Legion War 5v5, about 260x260 studs) across linked rooftops, built for vertical dash fights

districts.name: Old Quarter
districts.blurb: Stone streets and a ruined shrine where live-event rifts open.
districts.mood: overcast and rainy, mossy stone, rifts in matte violet-black
districts.lore: This is where the seven seconds never fully ended. The rifts are time stutters.
